controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.ssh-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T10:34:24.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:34:24.500Z"
| WHERE source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
        AND zeek.ssh.client IS NOT NULL
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY zeek.ssh.client, zeek.ssh.auth.success
| SORT events DESC
